# Documentation changes

Follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`. Use explicit labels such as proposed, accepted, historical observation, or implemented with evidence. Preserve links to the proposal section or primary source behind a technical claim.

Keep current state in `docs/project-state.md`, decisions in `docs/decisions/`, and durable handoff notes in `docs/handoffs/current.md`. Do not repeat the entire specification in agent adapters. Link new documents from `docs/README.md`; check changed relative links and contradictory completion claims.
